title: Ramayana: Part 1 crosses ₹800 crore worldwide in six days (₹823.5 cr gross, 5–10 Nov, Sacnilk); India net ₹440.45 cr
headline: Ramayana Crosses ₹800 Crore Worldwide in Six Days
caption:
Ramayana: Part 1 has grossed about ₹823.5 crore worldwide after six days (5–10 Nov), trade tracker Sacnilk estimates.

That is ₹526.5 crore gross from India and ₹297 crore from overseas. India net stands at ₹440.45 crore. Its biggest day so far was Monday 9 Nov at ₹107.5 crore net (Bollywood Hungama counts ₹103.47 crore), and Tuesday held at ₹94.1 crore, down 12.5%.

The Hindi version accounts for ₹336 crore of the India net. Kannada is next at ₹41.2 crore, ahead of Telugu (₹33 crore), Tamil (₹17.35 crore) and Malayalam (₹12.9 crore).

JioHotstar will stream it as a pay-per-view release after its cinema run; no date or price yet.

Which language did you watch Ramayana in, or are you waiting for JioHotstar?

Sources: Sacnilk, Business Today, ETV Bharat, Bollywood Hungama, Prime Focus, Outlook
